messages:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — Zephyr Health wants a 3-week POC to validate note retrieval + LLM summarization for clinicians. They care about PHI controls, summary accuracy, and a smooth integration. Need to align success criteria, auth model, quota bump, and streaming for long notes. Who can join the kickoff?

devon_se: I can. Asking: are we prioritizing quality metrics or latency/cost for the POC? Also need their expected daily volume.

mike_prod: Primary success = quality + safety. Proposed thresholds: (1) avg embedding-similarity >= 0.80 on their eval set, (2) P95 summary latency < 1s for single-editor flow, (3) private infra (no PHI in hosted plane) or clear contractual controls, (4) integration finished within 3 weeks.

anjali_security: PHI means Private deployment or customer-managed KMS + audit logs. Please get their network diagram and confirm if VPC-peering is acceptable or they need on-prem. Also we'll need them to sign NDA and fill security questionnaire items 3, 6, 11 re: encryption/key rotation/SOC2.

ryan_engineering: For integration we recommend our SDKs (py/node) — streaming + incremental summarization are easier there. Example Python snippet for streaming responses:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
for chunk in client.chat.stream(model='rwd-3b', messages=messages):
    ui.emit(chunk)
```

ryan_engineering: Also: include an input-hash id for idempotency on summarize calls. SDKs have built-in backoff; for REST, respect Retry-After and use exponential backoff.

emma_solutions: Quotas: hosted trial defaults are low. For POC we can request a temporary increase — recommend requesting 400k tokens/day and 600 rps burst for 21 days. Sales: confirm expected qps and tokens so I can file RW-POC ticket.

legal_bot: Reminder: do not exchange PHI until NDA executed. I can send a templated NDA; Sara, confirm recipient.

devon_se: For long notes we’ll provide a chunker + prefix-cache approach so we don't re-encode entire context each update. Will push a sample chunker and client helper to the repo. Streaming partial summaries will help UI responsiveness.

mike_prod: Pricing for POC: offer credits covering expected token use; define overage rules (charged at eval rate). Sales: get confirmation before committing.

anjali_security: Also confirm retention policy — they asked for no persistent PHI in hosted service. Options: Private deployment OR ephemeral-mode with TTL=0 plus contract clause. Need product/legal input.

emma_solutions: Filed quota request RW-POC-2981 (requested: 600 rps burst, 400k tokens/day x21d). Waiting on infra approval (ETA 24-48h).

ryan_engineering: Note on retries: if client resubmits without idempotency key we could duplicate processing. Best practice: attach input hash and mark request idempotent. For 429s, start with linear backoff (200-500ms) then escalate to exponential.

sara_sales: Action list: (1) Ryan + Devon: share integration guide + sample repo by Tue EOD, (2) Emma: confirm quota ticket + pricing credit plan, (3) Anjali: draft initial security responses and required docs, (4) Mike: finalize success metric thresholds and collect their eval prompts. Internal review Thurs.

devon_se: I'll add a tiny test harness so they can run local evals against sample prompts. Will include streaming config and retry knobs.

legal_bot: NDA template sent to zephyr-contact@zephyr.com — awaiting signature.

deploy-bot: RW-POC-2981 status: pending-review by infra-team.

mike_prod: Potential blocker: if Zephyr mandates fully air-gapped on-prem install we may need to push timeline and involve infra. Flagging early.

emma_solutions: If infra approves quotas we can proceed with demo provisioning this week.

sara_sales: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Zephyr for Mon 10am PT and invite this thread. Please keep replies short in the sync so we can hit the agenda. :thumbsup:

participants: sara_sales, devon_se, mike_prod, anjali_security, ryan_engineering, emma_solutions, legal_bot, deploy-bot
